title: Reuse saved Plus audio across devices
acceptance: Same verified Plus billing account or individual administrator can retrieve an unchanged successful render across devices without a second provider call or debit.
Concurrent misses, lost responses, ambiguous provider outcomes and deletion races cannot create duplicate spending.
Cache identity covers effective text and synthesis settings, canonical timings rebuild different phrase segmentation, and owner isolation holds on every read and delete.
Finite storage and retention, explicit deletion, unchanged entitlement policies and browser logout behavior are tested and disclosed.
Required PR checks and exact deployment evidence are recorded separately from real-device/live-provider acceptance; checkout remains disabled.

evidence.note: Draft review; not merged or deployed. Private-provider credentials remain a separate blocker.
